task: Add a user-facing --dry-run flag to CodeMie CLI commands that previews planned actions without changing anything, delivered in phases starting with install/uninstall, setup, profile, config and docs install.

key_reasoning.reason: Phase 1 spans the install/uninstall, setup, profile, config and docs command factories plus a new shared dry-run abstraction (option helper and gating of exec/npm/ConfigLoader writes). No central option or hook seam exists today. Touches the shared exec/processes utilities and BaseAgentAdapter install/uninstall.

Semantics are undefined for read-only and machine-invoked commands (hook, mcp-proxy, list, doctor). Output format, handling of prompts and metrics side effects, and unsupported-command behaviour are open design decisions. Name collision with CODEMIE_SESSION_DRY_RUN and runOptions.dryRun.

Phase 1 alone is roughly 12-16 files: several command factories, shared option helper, exec/processes, ConfigLoader, BaseAgentAdapter and the framework installers. Later phases would reach dozens of command files.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope kept at XL: touches core shared utilities (exec/processes, ConfigLoader) and affects multiple commands
Requirements Clarity bumped to L: vague semantics for non-mutating commands and open design decisions
